Decide eligible_for_provisional_credit for each dispute using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines. Every criterion must hold:
(1) The account has been open at least 60 days: open date from get_accounts to today from get_time.
(2) The reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or it is goods_services_not_received with a purchase date from the records more than 30 days before today.

(4) No more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (check_dispute_history, or running_dispute_count when several disputes are filed).
(5) For a reason other than fraud, the merchant was contacted.
If any criterion fails, set it to false.

rewrite.do:
Act on what the filing reply says.
- The reply says a dispute may already have been filed for this transaction: do not retry and do not add to the running count. Tell the customer the system reports that a dispute may already have been filed for this charge, and continue with the next dispute.
- A missing or invalid parameter error: correct the value the error names from the steps above (an exact allowed value or an MM/DD/YYYY date) and call again.
- If it still fails: explain the problem and ask whether the customer wants a human agent. Call transfer_to_human_agents only if they say yes, with reason code technical_system_error.

(c) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards, Crypto-Cash Back) $2500.00; Mid Tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $5000.00; Premium Tier (Gold Rewards, Business Gold Rewards) $10000.00; Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum Rewards) $15000.00; Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite) $25000.00. steps.do: Tell the customer, for each charge, whether the dispute was filed and whether provisional credit applies. If it does not, give the reason in general terms: reason type, under $25.00 or over the tier maximum, merchant not contacted, purchase within 30 days, account under 60 days, or dispute count. Also say that the case will be reviewed within 10 business days.
steps.quote: When you file a dispute with our customer service team, they will let you know whether provisional credit applies to your situation.

rules.rule: Provisional credit is true only if all of these hold: the account has been open 60 days or more; the reason is fraud or duplicate, or not received with a purchase more than 30 days ago; the amount is from $25.00 up to the tier maximum; no more than 2 disputes were filed in the past 12 months; and, for a non-fraud dispute, the merchant was contacted.
